x: Dave Mayo, Carl Lawton, Bernard Capener and Brian Ward gave Belgrave a magnificent start to 1968 by defeating strong opposition from Trowbridge and winning the Garnet Cup by just two points.

Our only representative in the Birmingham Outer Circle was Bernard Capener who finished this tough 25 Miler in a very good 4.09.28. At this rate Bernard will soon be troubling our more experienced distance men.

While on May 2nd, Ray once again triumphed over his fellow postmen to win the 15 Kilos in 72 :25. In the same race Bernard Capener finished 8th in 80 : 20 and that old campaigner George Beecham 19th in 91 : 21

Another much improved walker is Bernard Capener who should feature in the international postman's walk in September. Those Belgrave landmarks John Keown, John Morris and George Beecham are still very much alive and will, one hopes shortly be joined by John Johnson.

Belgrave's other representative Bernard Capener did not live up to the promise he showed earlier this year. Suffering from a heavy cold, heavier uniform, heat, lack of training and lack of speed he finished 29th in 1hr25min
On the same day Ray Middleton won the 6 miles round the City Postman's walk in 47:45. Bernard Capener finished 2nd in 55:05
